831914010:int:557717086.h: Five interceptions from [[p:557717086|S.Jones]] bury [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] at Charlotte
831914010:int:557717086.d: [[p:557717086|S.Jones]] went 19-of-41 for 219 yards and two touchdowns, but five picks gave [[t:832438291|Charlotte]] the game. Pirate_flag now has a quarterback question to answer before next week.

quote.text: Some of those throws, he's got to throw away. Period.
quote.by: a source close to the East Carolina program

831914837:comeback.h: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] wins the fourth 19-7 and steals one from [[t:832438285|Boston College]]
831914837:comeback.d: Down 31-20 after three quarters, Clemson came back to win 39-38. Boston College had control of this game and lost it.

831914506:ot.d: Indiana won the extra period 21-19 after regulation settled nothing. Neither defense will like the tape.

831914749:4th:832438343.h: [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]] goes 2-for-5 on fourth down, and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] reaps the rewards
831914749:4th:832438343.d: Three turnovers on downs left Mississippi State with a play-calling debate. Some fans will want to know why the staff left points on the board.

832438366:streakW6.h: Six straight wins have [[t:832438366|Penn State]] at 6-1 and up to No. 16
832438366:streakW6.d: [[c:Agerm40|Agerm40]] has the Nittany Lions rolling, and the locker room has bought in. Players say the message hasn't changed through the streak.

quote.text: We don't talk about the streak. We talk about Tuesday practice.

831914626:ot.h: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] edges [[t:832438311|Fresno State]] 33-30 after a 6-3 extra period
831914626:ot.d: Boise State needed overtime and won the extra period 6-3. Two field goals' worth of tension ended with the Broncos on top.

831914638:int:557718877.h: [[p:557718877|L.Moga]]'s six interceptions wreck [[t:832438350|New Mexico]] against [[t:832438272|Air Force]]
831914638:int:557718877.d: Moga threw for 260 yards and a score, but six picks made the game unwinnable. Air Force took advantage of the gifts.

quote.text: You can't win giving it away that many times. It's on all of us.

831914779:int:557725258.h: [[p:557725258|J.Long]]'s three picks tilt the game toward [[t:832438312|Georgia]] over [[t:832438328|Kentucky]]
831914779:int:557725258.d: Long threw for 286 yards and a touchdown, but three interceptions made the difference in Kentucky's loss. Moving the ball wasn't the problem.

831914535:pass:557723017.h: [[p:557723017|D.Williams Jr.]] throws for 472 yards as Nebraska handles [[t:832438408|Washington]]
831914535:pass:557723017.d: Williams Jr. went 33-of-45 without an interception in a 24-10 win. Nebraska's passing game looks like the real thing.

831914840:4th:832438314.h: [[t:832438314|Georgia State]]'s fourth-down aggression backfires in loss to [[t:832438323|James Madison]]
831914840:4th:832438314.d: Georgia State converted two of five and turned it over on downs three times. The analytics argument won't calm a restless fan base.

831914853:rivalry.h: [[t:832438337|Miami]] takes the Virginia Tech game in a runaway
831914853:rivalry.d: It was never close, and Miami keeps bragging rights for another year. Virginia Tech will spend the offseason thinking about it.

831914324:pass:557715753.h: [[p:557715753|W.Hammond]] throws for 447 yards as Texas Tech rolls 52-14
831914324:pass:557715753.d: Hammond completed 28 of 40 without a pick against [[t:832438322|Jacksonville State]]. Texas Tech's offense looks nearly impossible to stop.

831914822:4th:832438330.h: [[t:832438330|Louisiana]] misses on three fourth-down tries and falls to [[t:832438279|Arkansas State]]
831914822:4th:832438330.d: Louisiana went 1-for-4 on fourth down and turned it over on downs three times. Arkansas State's defense made the stops.

831914533:def:557717690.d: Reeshad had five tackles, four for loss, in Oregon's 24-16 win. Purdue's quarterback never got comfortable.

831914441:pass:557720861.h: [[p:557720861|A.Schobel]]'s five touchdowns fall short against [[t:832438321|Iowa State]], 49-47
831914441:pass:557720861.d: Schobel threw for 455 yards and five scores on 38-of-56 passing, with two interceptions. It still wasn't enough in a loss that will sting.

831914559:int:557711829.h: [[p:557711829|D.Bailey]]'s three picks sink [[t:832438372|Sam Houston]] against [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]]
831914559:int:557711829.d: Bailey went 18-of-39 for 206 yards and two touchdowns, and the interceptions decided it. Sam Houston's offense had little margin.

831914575:ot.h: [[t:832438351|New Mexico State]] tops [[t:832438345|Missouri State]] 30-27 in overtime
831914575:ot.d: New Mexico State won the extra period 6-3 in a game that went down to the last kick. Both teams ended up leaning on field goals.

831914610:ot.d: Eastern Michigan took the extra period 15-13 and left Ohio with another near miss. A team on the road can take a lot from that.

831914663:ot.h: [[t:832438388|Toledo]] shuts the door on [[t:832438338|Miami University]] in overtime, 38-31
831914663:ot.d: Toledo won the extra period 7-0 after a regulation stalemate. Miami University had the first shot and came up empty.

831914566:flags:832438341.h: 13 penalties for 97 yards doom [[t:832438341|Middle Tennessee]] against [[t:832438329|Liberty]]
831914566:flags:832438341.d: Middle Tennessee kept stalling its own drives and kept giving Liberty free yards. Expect discipline to take over practice this week.

quote.text: Every drive felt like it started 10 yards behind.

831914686:rivalry.h: [[t:832438333|LSU]] puts away Texas A&M in a lopsided rivalry win
831914686:rivalry.d: It wasn't close, and LSU keeps this one for another year. Texas A&M faces a long offseason.

831913999:def:557711553.h: [[p:557711553|J.Allen]] wrecks [[t:832438382|Temple]] with four sacks in Memphis's 34-16 win
831913999:def:557711553.d: Allen finished with six tackles, four for loss. Temple never found a way to block him.

831914890:def:557725233.h: [[p:557725233|X.Lewis]] gets three sacks against [[t:832438379|Stanford]] in a losing effort
831914890:def:557725233.d: Lewis finished with five tackles, all for loss, in a game his team still lost. It was a huge performance that didn't change the result.

831914349:flags:832438374.h: [[t:832438374|San Jose State]] commits 12 penalties and loses to [[t:832438297|UConn]]
831914349:flags:832438374.d: The Spartans were flagged 12 times for 95 yards. UConn didn't need to do much more than wait.

831914510:3rd:832438318.h: [[t:832438318|Illinois]] converts 2 of 11 third downs in a loss to [[t:832438394|UCLA]]
831914510:3rd:832438318.d: Illinois couldn't extend drives, and UCLA took advantage. The money down was a problem all day.

831914849:rec:557715761.h: [[p:557715761|M.Hamper]] burns [[t:832438310|Florida State]] for 175 yards and a touchdown
831914849:rec:557715761.d: Hamper caught eight passes, including a 52-yarder, and gave the Seminoles' secondary problems all afternoon. Coaches there probably lost sleep over the tape.

561124210battle.h: Georgia holds a 17-point edge on Ohio State for [[r:561124210|B. Tippmann]]
561124210battle.d: Georgia leads 255-238, with Alabama at 116. Tippmann's dealbreaker is proximity to home, and official visits could swing it. Sources say Tuddy_roosevelt's staff is pushing for a trip to Columbus.

561119306battle.h: Penn State clings to a one-point lead over Texas for [[r:561119306|Q. Vigil]]
561119306battle.d: Penn State leads 64-63, with Florida at 62. Vigil's dealbreaker is conference prestige. The win streak under [[c:Agerm40|Agerm40]] gives the Nittany Lions a recruiting pitch.

561125692battle.d: SMU is ahead 653-587, with LSU at 479. His dealbreaker is conference prestige, which is where Oklahoma sees its opening. A source says the Sooners aren't giving up.

561122126battle.h: Texas leads Georgia by 20 points for [[r:561122126|P. Leber]], but not by much
561122126battle.d: Texas is ahead 654-634, with Ohio State at 221. Leber cares most about playing style, and both programs have been selling their offenses. One of them will lose out on signing day.

561124114battle.h: Notre Dame holds one-point edge over Utah for five-star Virgin, with SMU lurking
561124114battle.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] leads [[t:832438400|Utah]] 60 to 59 for five-star ATH [[r:561124114|C. Virgin]], and SMU sits at 58. Playing time is his dealbreaker, so expect the pitches this week to be about the depth chart.

quote.text: He wants to know when he's on the field, not when he's on the roster.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561119798battle.h: Colorado clings to a slim lead over Georgia for Manuwai
561119798battle.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] leads [[t:832438312|Georgia]] 61 to 60 for four-star MIKE [[r:561119798|L. Manuwai]], with LSU at 58. Playing style is the dealbreaker, and Georgia's staff reportedly isn't conceding anything.

561120351commit.h: Georgia lands five-star Duggan, who says he came to chase a title
561120351commit.d: [[r:561120351|J. Duggan]] picks [[t:832438312|Georgia]], which grades out an A+ as a championship contender. The Bulldogs also rank first in NIL spending, and a source put his asking price at about $410K.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561124450commit.h: Alabama never trailed for Reinbolt, who fell for the head coach
561124450commit.d: [[r:561124450|A. Reinbolt]] commits to [[t:832438274|Alabama]] after a recruitment that was never close. The win over No. 24 [[t:832438308|Florida]] didn't hurt, but he says the staff sold him from the first call.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561121384commit.h: Indiana's title pitch lands four-star Hamrick after the win over Minnesota
561121384commit.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] wins the tug-of-war for four-star SAM [[r:561121384|T. Hamrick]]. The Hoosiers grade out an A as a championship contender, and beating No. 18 [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] gave the pitch some weight.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561120600commit.h: Texas Tech beats LSU and Kansas State for Pope
561120600commit.d: [[r:561120600|M. Pope]] chooses [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] over [[t:832438333|LSU]] and [[t:832438325|Kansas State]]. The Red Raiders' 52-14 rout of [[t:832438322|Jacksonville State]] came at a helpful time for a recruit looking for a title shot.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561125736commit.h: Ole Miss adds edge rusher Abbott and a way to replace two seniors
561125736commit.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] lands four-star LEDG [[r:561125736|J. Abbott]]. [[p:557719851|Y.Pierre]] and [[p:557715042|K.Franklin]] are both seniors, and the Rebels have sent five defensive linemen to the draft in four years, so Abbott sees a quick route to the field.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561125364commit.h: Hammer picks Notre Dame over Texas and Michigan
561125364commit.d: [[r:561125364|J. Hammer]] commits to [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], choosing it over [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438339|Michigan]]. The 21-16 rivalry win over [[t:832438398|USC]] helped, and Hammer wanted a team that grades as a title contender.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561123749commit.h: Utah's staff wins over four-star edge Davis
561123749commit.d: [[r:561123749|J. Davis]] picks [[t:832438400|Utah]] and says the coaching staff made the difference. With [[p:557714121|E.Day]] and [[p:557718724|J.Mickens]] both out of eligibility after the season, Davis could step into a wide-open edge room.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561119452commit.h: Oregon's NFL line pipeline lands tackle Jose
561119452commit.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] lands four-star RT [[r:561119452|A. Jose]]. The Ducks rank first nationally in pro potential at offensive line, and a source says the NIL package was around $265K, which helped as well.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

561121196commit.h: Burns picks Ole Miss for the TV windows and the NFL track record
561121196commit.d: [[r:561121196|P. Burns]], a four-star REDG, commits to [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]]. He wanted the national spotlight, and the Rebels offered A- brand exposure plus a defensive line that has sent two first-rounders to the draft recently.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561124523commit.h: Oklahoma lands LeBeau with a pitch of immediate playing time
561124523commit.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] gets four-star WR [[r:561124523|C. LeBeau]]. The Sooners have only seven returning receivers, and LeBeau says the staff told him the job is his to win.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561123309commit.h: UCLA beats BYU for Ojulari, who pointed to the head coach
561123309commit.d: [[r:561123309|K. Ojulari]] picks [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438288|BYU]]. The Bruins' coaching staff grades out an A for prestige, and the NIL offer, reportedly around $255K, closed it.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561123468commit.h: Clemson adds athlete Doss, who wanted a bigger stage
561123468commit.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] lands four-star ATH [[r:561123468|B. Doss]]. Doss was looking for national exposure, and the Tigers' NIL ranking of ninth, with a reported $285K ask, did the rest.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561124212commit.h: Texas lands linebacker Paillant as Sherman's replacement
561124212commit.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] gets four-star SAM [[r:561124212|M. Paillant]]. [[p:557721040|K.Sherman]] is a senior, so the position is open, and Texas ranks fifth in the country in pro potential at linebacker.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Texas develops linebackers better than anybody.

561125337commit.h: Ansah leaves home for Texas A&M, where linebacker depth is thin
561125337commit.d: [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] lands four-star SAM [[r:561125337|D. Ansah]]. He called proximity to home a dealbreaker, then picked a school far from it. The Aggies have just three returning linebackers, and he says a starting job is his to win.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561125516commit.h: Miami gets Emery with a contender's pitch and a rivalry win
561125516commit.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] lands four-star LEDG [[r:561125516|J. Emery]]. The 32-18 win over [[t:832438406|Virginia Tech]] came at a good time, and the Hurricanes grade out an A+ as a championship contender.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561123015commit.h: Goedeke stays in California and picks UCLA
561123015commit.d: Four-star LEDG [[r:561123015|E. Goedeke]] commits to [[t:832438394|UCLA]] and keeps the Bruins in the state's recruiting win column. A source close to the family says he never seriously considered leaving California, and his reported ask was $270K.

quote.text: I'm representing San Juan Capistrano. Staying close was always the plan.

561119694commit.h: USC picks up receiver Heflin, who wanted the spotlight
561119694commit.d: [[t:832438398|USC]] lands four-star WR [[r:561119694|L. Heflin]]. The Trojans grade out an A- in brand exposure and rank tenth nationally in pro potential at receiver, a combination that suits a player with an eye on his profile.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561123609commit.h: Miami's linebacker room gets a new name in Wells
561123609commit.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] lands four-star WILL [[r:561123609|L. Wells]]. [[p:557720045|C.Pruitt]] is a senior, so the position opens up, and Wells says the Hurricanes' title chances made the decision easy.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561124656commit.h: Nebraska runs away with the race for linebacker Coffee
561124656commit.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] lands four-star MIKE [[r:561124656|D. Coffee]] after more than tripling Florida's influence. Coffee wanted to play in a power conference, and the Cornhuskers' A+ grade for conference prestige met that.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

557723218:underpaid.h: W.Wilson is an 89-overall quarterback with no NIL deal
557723218:underpaid.d: [[p:557723218|W.Wilson]] earns nothing in NIL, while quarterbacks with his rating command around $170K. If his school doesn't act, the portal may do it for them. A quarterback this good will get calls.

557720389:underpaid.h: Penn State has a B.Riker problem: his pay is far below market
557720389:underpaid.d: [[p:557720389|B.Riker]] is an 84-overall center making $30K, while players at his position and rating get about $75K. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] is on a six-game winning streak, but agerm40 should check on how happy the offensive line is. A source says rival staffs have noticed.

557717122:fit.h: Penn State's pass defense could cost it J.Joseph
557717122:fit.d: [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ranks 112th of 138 in pass yards allowed per game, and [[p:557717122|J.Joseph]] is an 82-overall field corner. A source close to the program says he has looked at other situations. Even a winning streak may not stop him from testing the market.

quote.text: You want to be in a system that lets you make plays on the ball.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726826:fit.h: Zayas is another Penn State corner worth watching in the portal
557726826:fit.d: [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] is an 82-overall field corner at a school ranked 112th of 138 in pass yards allowed per game. With [[t:832438366|Penn State]] winning, he may be patient, but players with this kind of mismatch often test the market.

557722831:buried.h: I.West is too good to sit, and a transfer may be coming
557722831:buried.d: [[p:557722831|I.West]] is an 85-overall sophomore running back who has played only 53 snaps in seven games. Any team in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

quote.text: He's got the talent to start anywhere. Somebody will make him a promise.

557720545:buried.h: A.Rogers, stuck fourth on Ohio State's depth chart, may look elsewhere
557720545:buried.d: [[p:557720545|A.Rogers]] is an 84-overall junior running back with 41 snaps in seven games for Ohio State. Tuddy_roosevelt has a deep backfield, but another team would start him tomorrow.

557719944:buried.h: Porter is a 90-overall receiver, and teams want him
557719944:buried.d: [[p:557719944|Q.Porter]] is a junior receiver rated 90 overall, with 74 snaps in seven games. Any team in the portal market would start him, and his camp has reportedly heard from several programs.

557714800:struggling.h: B.Ficklin is rated 90, but his stats don't match
557714800:struggling.d: [[p:557714800|B.Ficklin]] has gone 132-of-220 for 1,639 yards, 11 touchdowns and seven interceptions, a 132.7 rating. That is not enough for a 90-overall quarterback on a ranked team, and the staff has a big decision to make this offseason.

557714066:underpaid.h: Liberty has an 87-overall running back for free in K.Davis, but for how long?
557714066:underpaid.d: [[p:557714066|K.Davis]] makes nothing in NIL, while backs with his rating command around $90K. [[t:832438329|Liberty]] ranks 91st in NIL spending and can't win a bidding war, so the Flames may have a difficult offseason.

557720462:fit.h: Georgia's Leaky Pass Defense Could Push Elite Corner E.Robinson IV Toward the Portal
557720462:fit.d: [[p:557720462|E.Robinson IV]] is a 97-overall bump-and-run corner, and [[t:832438312|Georgia]] ranks 113th of 138 in pass yards allowed per game. Players with that kind of mismatch tend to test the market in the offseason.

quote.text: You want to play in a system that lets you press and trust your help. That isn't happening right now.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

557726198:underpaid.h: Rival Collectives Eye Georgia Safety J.Smith, Who Is Reportedly Making Nothing in NIL
557726198:underpaid.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] is an 86-overall safety, and comparable players are reportedly commanding around 80K. [[t:832438312|Georgia]] ranks first nationally in NIL resources, which gives it room to fix the gap before someone else exploits it.

quote.text: Everyone knows the number at his position. Somebody is going to put it in front of him.
quote.by: a source at a rival collective

557715998:struggling.h: T.Hawkins Has Been Fine for SMU. For an 88-Overall Quarterback, Fine Isn't Enough
557715998:struggling.d: [[p:557715998|T.Hawkins]] is 177-of-256 for 2,284 yards with 15 touchdowns and 7 interceptions, a 157.9 rating. That's respectable on paper, but it falls short of what a ranked [[t:832438375|SMU]] team should expect from this rating. The staff has a real call to make this offseason.

557725512:sinking.h: I.Mizell Is Stuck on a 2-5 Arizona Team, and Every Contender Knows It
557725512:sinking.d: [[p:557725512|I.Mizell]] is a 91-overall junior receiver on a team that has lost its way. If he enters the portal, he becomes the most sought-after receiver on the market. Rival staffs are said to be preparing already.

557719455:sinking.h: Michigan State's 1-6 Start Puts WR D.Olugbode on Contenders' Radar
557719455:sinking.d: [[p:557719455|D.Olugbode]] is a 91-overall junior receiver on a team that has won once. If he hits the portal, he'd be one of the offseason's biggest stories. Contenders will be waiting.

quote.text: Nobody blames a guy like that for wanting to play meaningful games.
quote.by: an assistant at a Power conference program

557724828:sinking.h: Michigan Is 1-7, and S.Hiter Is a 90-Overall Back Worth Chasing
557724828:sinking.d: [[p:557724828|S.Hiter]] is a 90-overall sophomore running back on a team that has won once. If he enters the portal, rival staffs will line up, and he still has years of eligibility left.

557714937:struggling.h: J.Foley's 241 Yards in Seven Games Don't Match His 87 Overall
557714937:struggling.d: [[p:557714937|J.Foley]] has 13 catches for 241 yards in 7 games. That's thin for an 87-overall receiver billed as a star. Expect his staff to weigh his role, and his future, this offseason.

557722222:struggling.h: B.Trimble Has 13 Catches for 136 Yards, and Staffs May Look Elsewhere
557722222:struggling.d: [[p:557722222|B.Trimble]] is rated 86 overall, but 13 receptions for 136 yards in seven games tells a weaker story. Don't be surprised if his coaches scan the portal at receiver.

quote.text: The rating got him the job. The production will decide whether he keeps it.
quote.by: a source close to the program
